backend child powershell.exe Start-Process includes -WindowStyle Hidden

rationale: GUI executables are not XiaoYu-owned console shells and must not be blindly hidden; the contract targets only console-bearing launch points owned by the overlay.
acceptance_plan: add one test_overlay_contract method that requires the main shortcut hidden argument
require the one-click child powershell Start-Process block to retain -WindowStyle Hidden
require the restore-state Python Start-Process block to retain -WindowStyle Hidden
keep the existing PowerShell parser, patched-product, execution, QQ and release gates green
do not claim that unrelated machine scheduled tasks are fixed without live Local Operator evidence

live_acceptance.claim_scope: The repository contract proves XiaoYu-owned console launch semantics cannot silently lose Hidden; it does not prove unrelated machine tasks cannot create terminals.

retirement_condition: Retire this overlay contract only if XiaoYu's wrapper scripts/shortcut are removed in favor of a native N.E.K.O launcher path that owns equivalent no-console startup behavior.

implementation.change: add one static overlay contract that binds the three XiaoYu-owned console-bearing launch points to existing Windows -WindowStyle Hidden semantics
